description: Permanently delete a whole review: its items, comments and screenshots. Its link stops working for everyone it was shared with. This cannot be undone. Only the review's owner (a signed-in connection) or the agent that created an unsaved review (its claim_token) can delete it; an agent token handed over from the review page cannot.

claim_token.description: The claim_token from create_review (or the owner's agent token).

name: delete_review
